title: Etale unbounded closed-support tensor projection
statement: Let i:Z → T be a closed immersion with complementary open j:U → T. Let R be any commutative ring sheaf on T_et and R_Z=i^{-1}R. Let iStar be an additive left adjoint to the actual module direct image. Let p and q be functors on ordinary unbounded derived categories, pinned by the given termwise-localization isomorphisms to iStar and actual closed direct image, respectively. With native derived tensors [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor] there is a natural isomorphism q(N) tensor_T K ≅ q(N tensor_Z p(K)), natural simultaneously in every N in D(R_Z) and K in D(R). There is no boundedness, Tor, finiteness or constancy assumption on complexes or coefficients, and no exceptional adjoint or dualizing object appears.

source.place: The middle projection identity in the displayed Hom chain, and the following paragraph: closed exact fully faithful extension by zero commutes with tensor; flat resolutions give the derived identity.

proof.text: Identify arbitrary-coefficient module inverse image with abelian inverse image, including units and counits. First use the constructed module adjunction, transport its ring along uniqueness of ring inverse image, and finally use uniqueness of module left adjoints. Scalar forgetting detects exactness. Closed finite direct image is exact; its counit is invertible. Open restriction of closed direct image is zero, and the closed/open pair detects isomorphisms after forgetting scalars.

Pass this exact module adjunction to termwise derived functors by localization. Its counit remains invertible. Homology comparison gives complementary-open vanishing on every derived closed complex and derived joint detection. The exactDerivedAdjunction helpers are used with the actual etale module categories, without requiring a special coefficient object.

Apply native tensor pullback for both i and j. Tensoring a zero object by any K is zero because tensorRight has the native internal-Hom right adjoint. Thus open restriction of X = qi(N) tensor K is zero. Closed restriction of the adjunction unit on X is invertible by the triangle identity and invertible counit, and its open restriction is between zero objects. Joint detection makes the unit invertible.

Whisker the invertible unit with tensor pullback and the closed counit to obtain the projection isomorphism, naturally in both variables. Uniqueness of localization lifts identifies exact derived pi and qi with the supplied iPull and iPush using their Q factorizations, and transports this isomorphism to the displayed statement.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleClosedTensorProjection
    {T Z U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    (R : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (iStar : closedCostalkEtaleModules T R ⥤
      closedCostalkEtaleModules Z ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback i).obj R))
    [iStar.Additive] (ai : iStar ⊣ closedCostalkEtaleModulePush i R)
    (iPull : DerivedCategory (closedCostalkEtaleModules T R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (closedCostalkEtaleModules Z ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback i).obj R)))
    (pullFactors : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ iPull ≅
      iStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (iPush : DerivedCategory
        (closedCostalkEtaleModules Z ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback i).obj R)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (closedCostalkEtaleModules T R))
    (pushFactors : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ iPush ≅
      (closedCostalkEtaleModulePush i R).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q) :
    let RZ := ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback i).obj R)
    let tT := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} T.smallEtaleTopology R)
    let tZ := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} Z.smallEtaleTopology RZ)
    Nonempty ((iPush).prod (𝟭 _) ⋙ tT ≅
      (𝟭 _).prod (iPull) ⋙ tZ ⋙ (iPush))
